name: CompanyScope
description: Company intelligence MCP server — one tool call returns a full company profile from 8 free data sources: Wikipedia, GitHub, SEC EDGAR, OpenCorporates, RDAP, web scraping, Brave News, Hunter.io.

tools.name: lookup_company
tools.description: Get a comprehensive company profile from a domain or company name

tools.name: get_tech_stack
tools.description: Detect the technology stack a company uses

tools.name: get_key_people
tools.description: Find key people at a company with titles

tools.name: get_company_news
tools.description: Get recent news articles about a company

tools.name: get_corporate_registry
tools.description: Corporate registry data — incorporation, jurisdiction, officers

tools.name: get_financials
tools.description: SEC EDGAR financial data — revenue, net income, assets, stock tickers, filings
